subject.title: Slack: Include file attachment metadata in inbound message delivery to agents

question: Should OpenClaw add a shared cross-channel inbound attachment metadata contract for agents, or keep Slack file details limited to placeholders, media paths, and download-file?
rationale: The missing behavior is source-visible, but the durable fix changes the agent-facing channel/plugin API shape instead of only Slack internals.

options.title: Add shared attachment metadata
options.body: Introduce a channel-agnostic attachment metadata block and populate Slack file id/name/MIME/size without replacing existing media fields.

options.title: Keep current file access surfaces
options.body: Continue relying on placeholders, MediaPath/MediaType fields, and download-file for Slack workflows, and close or defer this direction.

options.title: Add a Slack-only extension
options.body: Expose Slack-only metadata now while accepting future cross-channel cleanup risk if other transports need the same contract.

recommendation.title: Add shared attachment metadata
recommendation.body: Introduce a channel-agnostic attachment metadata block and populate Slack file id/name/MIME/size without replacing existing media fields.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the strongest current code-history signal for the Slack media and shared inbound media projection surfaces.
